item.title: Comment on Thursday assorted links by Anon
item.description:
Reply to M:

#4: Supposedly according to Weiss, the vibes have changed away from bad radicalisation to all these positive things and its all so very rosy (including, apparently, Giorgia Meloni's economically successful governance), and yet there also are all these crazy people online now. Weird, huh?

You don't think that there's a healthy portion of the population who voted not to endorse lawless strongman tactics but to reject progressivism gone amok?

The number of people, even here, who cried bloody murder at Biden overreach and illiberal wokeism but now cheer on the current administration and their ends-justify-the-means approach is stunning to me. But I don't hope they don't represent the median voter, and if they do then we are screwed because the political checks are failing.
